beginner.stem: Which history line belongs to Xenon?
options: During the 1868 solar eclipse, Pierre Janssen and Norman Lockyer saw a yellow line in the solar spectrum that matched no known element.

beginner.stem: How does the catalog describe the discovery of Xenon?

Ramsay and Travers distilled the krypton fraction of liquid air still further.
